assets.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE production mobile app image asset, not a screenshot or phone mockup. Reference is the supplied original design board. Recreate the original phone's ENTIRE upper scenic area (header sky + lower boy-and-fox learning banner) as ONE seamless illustration. Output rectangular landscape 3:2 aspect ratio, preferably 1536x1024, full bleed square corners. NO rounded corners, no phone frame, no status bar, no navigation controls, no feature icons.
Composition: upper 29% is calm pale cyan sky with soft white clouds for native app brand/avatar/bell overlays; NO text or UI in that upper band. This sky flows smoothly into the vivid blue sky and school garden below. There must be NO horizontal seam, straight border, abrupt color transition or separate header panel.
Lower 71% must reproduce the original illustration very faithfully: cute primary-school boy with short wavy dark brown hair, blue hoodie and brown backpack, holding a green book; small orange fox with white cheeks to his right; distant colorful school, green rounded leaves at bottom, clouds. Boy and fox occupy right 53%, their heads begin below the reserved top band. Keep full faces visible, boy torso and book visible at bottom. Match the original characters, not a new character design.
Left of lower scene, paint EXACT Chinese headline in playful heavy lettering with a navy-blue outline and subtle offset blue shadow like the reference: first line "每天进步" in white, second line "一点点" in warm yellow. Put the headline at x=5%-46%, y=36%-64%. Under it a small slightly angled pale-yellow pill containing EXACT dark navy Chinese "好方法，让学习更轻松" and a tiny orange right-facing triangle, at x=5%-49%, y=69%-81%. These are the only words in the image.
CRITICAL texture: match reference soft 2D/2.5D storybook illustration, matte, gentle warm gradients, softly painted volumes and shallow shadows. Absolutely NO glossy plastic, NO specular highlights, NO 3D toy render, NO fur realism, NO bloom, no excessive shine. The book has NO Latin letters or English. All image edges fully filled, hard square 90 degree corners.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONLY ONE production full-width rectangular "今日学习任务" banner image, faithfully recreating the yellow task card INSIDE THE PHONE in the supplied design reference. Do not output a design board, phone, screenshot, outside labels or other cards. Wide 3.55:1 aspect ratio (e.g. 1536x432). Full bleed hard square corners, NO baked rounded corners, NO outer shadow, NO white margins.
Compose the WHOLE finished card as one cohesive image: far-left 0%-30% blue clipboard with white paper, green checkmarks and diagonal orange pencil, little star and gentle cyan sky at upper left. Creamy pale yellow across center and right. Soft green leaves along bottom, small school garden orange flower and leaves at far right. Make art smoothly transition into background, no rectangular patches or seams.
Typography exactly as reference: title "今日学习任务" bold dark navy at x=33%, y=14%-31%; subtitle "根据你的错题，推荐专属练习" muted slate-blue at x=33%, y=36%-49%. Crisp, accurately spelled Chinese.
A compact golden-yellow capsule BUTTON, matching the phone reference, at x=53%-94%, y=62%-91% (only 41% of banner width, about 29% of banner height). Dark navy exact label "开始学习" with right-arrow "→". Moderate text size, soft shallow warm shadow, no hard outline. DO NOT create a huge button across the center; preserve breathing room above and left. The button must be substantially narrower than the text area.
IMPORTANT: Leave top right x=84%-98%, y=6%-34% free of any writing or badge; native code will overlay dynamic question-count badge there. Do NOT paint "5题", any number, any count badge or a placeholder outline.
Texture must be faithful to original reference: soft matte 2D/2.5D cartoon illustration, softly shaded, gentle color transitions. NO glossy plastic or toy-like 3D rendering, no specular bright highlights, no metallic shine. No English letters.
